name: Bloqra Starter Templates
author: BeautifulPlugins

sections.description:
Bloqra Starter Templates gives you finished websites for the Bloqra block theme. Pick a starter site, choose which of its pages you want, and import. Pages, images, menus and your homepage setting land in place, so you can start editing straight away instead of starting from an empty page.

Every template is built entirely in the block editor with core blocks and the free Bloqra Blocks plugin, so nothing locks you in and everything stays editable in the Site Editor exactly as you would expect.

Choose the pages you want

After you pick a starter site you get a list of its pages, with every page selected. Uncheck the ones you do not need and they are skipped cleanly — the navigation menu is built without them, and any link that pointed at a skipped page points at your homepage instead, so you are not left with a menu full of dead links.

What gets imported

  • Pages, with their full block layouts
  • Images, added to your media library
  • Demo blog posts and categories, when the template includes them
  • A navigation menu, matching the pages you actually imported
  • Your homepage and blog page settings
  • The colour and font style the template was designed with

Built for the block editor

There is no page builder here and no editor to choose. Bloqra is a full site editing theme, and every template is native block markup using your theme’s own colour, spacing and typography presets. Switch to one of Bloqra’s style variations after importing and the whole site follows.

You can undo it

The plugin keeps a record of everything it creates. The Tools screen can remove every page, post and image it imported, and put your homepage settings back — without touching anything else on your site. Deleting the plugin never removes your content.

Works offline

If our photo library cannot be reached, templates still import completely using placeholder images bundled with the plugin, and you can download the real photographs later with one click. An import never fails because of an image.

External services

This plugin can download photographs from our media host at cdn.beautifulplugins.com when you import a starter template.

This service is optional. The plugin is fully functional without it: every template imports completely using placeholder images that ship inside the plugin. If the host cannot be reached, the import continues and tells you that placeholders were used.

  • What is sent: nothing but the HTTP request for a specific image file, identified by the plugin name and version. No personal data, no site data, no site address and no identifiers are transmitted.
  • When it happens: only while you are importing a starter template, or when you click “Download the real photos” on the Tools screen. Nothing is requested on any other screen, nothing is requested when you open the plugin, and nothing is requested on your site’s front end.
  • Who makes the request: your WordPress server, not your visitors’ browsers. Nobody visiting your website ever contacts this host.
  • What is received: image files. Nothing else.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the Bloqra theme.
  2. Install and activate the Bloqra Blocks plugin.
  3. Install and activate Bloqra Starter Templates.
  4. Go to Appearance → Starter Templates, pick a site and import it.
sections.faq:
Do I need the Bloqra theme?

Yes. The templates are designed against Bloqra’s theme.json presets, so they need Bloqra or a child theme of it to look right. The plugin tells you if the theme is not active.

Will importing delete my existing content?

No. Importing only adds pages, posts and images. It does change your homepage and blog page settings, which you can switch off before importing, and which the Tools screen can restore.

Can I import just one page?

Yes. Uncheck everything except the page you want. The homepage is always included, because a starter site without one is not a site.

Are some templates only for paying customers?

No. Every template is free to import. Some are built with blocks that live in a different plugin — the same way a store template needs WooCommerce — and the plugin tells you which plugins a template needs before you import it.

Does this plugin install or activate other plugins?

Only when you press the button for that plugin, one at a time. Each template lists what it needs under “This site needs”, and a plugin hosted on WordPress.org gets its own Install or Activate button there. Nothing is installed or activated by importing, and the Import button stays disabled until the list is settled, so the import itself never changes which plugins your site is running. Plugins that are not on WordPress.org are only ever linked to — this plugin will not download them. Nothing is ever deactivated.

What happens if the photo download fails?

The template still imports, using placeholder images. The Tools screen has a “Download the real photos” button that fills them in later when the connection works.

Can I undo an import?

Yes. Appearance → Starter Templates → Tools → Remove imported content deletes everything the plugin created and restores your homepage settings. It only ever removes what it created itself.

Does this work with WP-CLI?

Yes. wp bloqrast list, wp bloqrast import <slug> and wp bloqrast reset.

Does the plugin collect any data about my site?

No. There is no tracking, no analytics and no phone-home of any kind.
